verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Modal serves a structured llms.txt at modal.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, a 'Modal Documentation' summary). Docs pages, including the Sandboxes guide, are also served as raw markdown (.md), and many cited doc URLs (SDK reference, examples, release notes) use agent-friendly .md endpoints. That gives an agent a clear entry point and machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or promoting the llms.txt/markdown docs for agent use, and evidence on how complete the llms.txt index is.
